Reduce skill cooldown by 2 & increase NP Strength (3 turns) for yourself + Apply a state where Command Cards become unselectable for all allies excluding yourself <no effect when only 1 Servant on field> (1 time, 1 turn) + Redistribute Command Cards + Gain a large amount of C.
